# Security policy

Report security problems privately through
[GitHub's private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/derektrimm/hermes-mobile/security/advisories/new),
not in a public issue or pull request. Please give the maintainer reasonable time to fix a problem
before disclosing it.

In scope: anything that lets someone other than the configured login, on a configured device, use
the app or reach the Hermes backend through it; ways around the Origin check, the device allow-list
or the PC window guards; leaks of the backend token.
